Cordovox browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Cordovox OD-8 X-Drive Published on September 8, 2025 Cordovox overdrive pedal Information The Cordovox OD-8 X-Drive is an overdrive pedal designed around the classic JRC4558 chipset and equipped with German WIMA audio capacitors for signal clarity. It includes two additional interchangeable chipsets, TL072 and NE5532, allowing users to customize the pedal's tonal character. The circuit provides three selectable overdrive modes via a toggle switch: TS mode delivers a saturated variation of the classic TS-9 sound, BRIGHT mode emphasizes brightness, smooth saturation, and higher output, while WARM mode provides a warm, high-gain overdrive tone. The pedal is equipped with TONE, VOLUME, and DRIVE controls, providing flexible shaping of the overdrive response. A true bypass footswitch with LED indicator manages effect engagement and bypass status. Housed in a durable metal chassis with a mirror-finished surface, the OD-8 X-Drive combines rugged construction with a polished appearance. Signal transfer is optimized for speed and low loss, and the unit supports dual power supply options via 9V battery or 9V DC adapter. The OD-8 X-Drive is an OEM pedal manufactured by Biyang and has also been distributed under other brand names. Controls Toggle switch: selects between TS, BRIGHT, and WARM modes TONE knob VOLUME knob DRIVE knob Footswitch with LED indicator Connections Input: 1/4" jack (impedance: 1MΩ) Output: 1/4" jack (impedance: 100KΩ) Technical Specifications Chipsets: JRC4558 (installed), TL072 and NE5532 (included) Capacitors: German WIMA audio capacitance Power supply: 9V battery (6LR61 alkaline or 6F22 carbon-zinc) or DC 9V 200mA adapter (center negative) Dimensions: approx. 9.5 x 12.5 x 4.5 cm / 3.7 x 4.9 x 1.8 in Weight: approx. 480 g / 16.9 oz Package dimensions: approx. 14 x 10.5 x 6.5 cm / 5.5 x 4.1 x 2.6 in Package weight: approx. 540 g / 19 oz Highlights Three selectable overdrive modes (TS, BRIGHT, WARM) Swappable chipsets with two extra op-amps included German WIMA capacitors for audio performance True bypass with LED status indicator Durable metal construction with mirror finish Dual power supply options (battery or adapter) OEM design manufactured by Biyang, also sold under other brand names Reviews myFXDB us
